name: Stéphanie Yon-Courtin - Après le § 46 - Am 6
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 46a. Calls on the Commission, when assessing mergers under EU competition rules, to evaluate potential harm to workers, including from employer concentration and the market power of global digital gatekeepers; underlines the associated risks, such as reduced job mobility, weakened collective bargaining, and downward pressure on wages and working conditions; stresses that competition enforcement must safeguard the social market economy by preventing excessive concentrations of market and labour market power from undermining EU labour standards;
